name: Claude
removalRules: Verified Chromium caches are selectable. VM disks, runtime downloads, local sessions, and other files stay protected.

section.title: Desktop data
section.summary: Desktop profiles, caches, virtual machines, and local tasks.

storage.name: Claude VM system disk
storage.explanation: Linux system and installed tools. This disk can also contain task files. Use Claude to manage it.

storage.name: Claude compressed VM download
storage.explanation: Compressed Linux runtime download. Moppo keeps it protected because Claude manages the VM installation.

storage.name: Claude VM session disk
storage.explanation: This disk can contain local task files. Its allocated size can be smaller than its virtual capacity.

storage.name: Claude VM files
storage.explanation: Virtual machine runtime and task files. Use Claude to manage these files.

storage.name: Claude downloaded tools
storage.explanation: Installed command-line tools. Use Claude to manage these files.

storage.name: Claude desktop coding sessions
storage.explanation: Saved coding tasks and their files. Use Claude to manage these files.

storage.name: Claude local agent sessions
storage.explanation: Task history, uploaded files, and outputs share this folder with persistent memories and plugins. Moppo keeps the whole folder protected.
